name: utopia-design
description: 👾 Utopia Design Protocol for utopia_ui: edit/rebrand design/tokens.json (DTCG), regenerate the Flutter theme plus an HTML twin surface, import external design sources (Figma, tokens.css/Tailwind @theme, a Claude Design handoff bundle, DESIGN.md), and build screens from designs using only manifest components - all gated on the project resolving utopia_ui. SessionStart detects utopia_ui and activates the skills; PostToolUse flags hardcoded theme values and malformed tokens files.
